name: Eggroll in a Bowl
author: Chari Crawley
steps: In a large, deep skillet, brown 1 lb of sausage.
Meanwhile in a small bowl, combine 5 cloves of garlic, 1/2 cup of soy sauce, and 1/2 tsp of ginger; set aside.
Once sausage is cooked through, add 1 bag of dry coleslaw mix to skillet and stir to combine.
Pour the soy sauce mixture into the skillet and stir, continuing to cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes or until cabbage is wilted, but still a bit crunchy. Serve with sliced green onion.
